summary: Added a PostgreSQL-aware SQL statement splitter and integrated eager whole-file validation into the migration runner. Statements retain original internal text and comments; empty and comment-only fragments are ignored. Existing migration discovery, connection patch seam, ledger, commit behavior, signatures, and console summaries are preserved.
coverage: Standard strings, escape strings, doubled quotes, quoted identifiers, case-sensitive dollar tags, identifier boundaries, and positional parameters
CR/LF/EOF line comments, nested block comments, preserved text, comment-only fragments, and unterminated-region errors
Whole-file validation before any migration statement execution; immediate file discovery, filename order, UTF-8, and empty-file ledger recording
Real PostgreSQL function and DO bodies, quoted semicolons, rerun skipping, and per-file rollback with earlier commits preserved
limitations: Ordinary strings assume standard_conforming_strings=on, as required.
SQL grammar validation, COPY FROM STDIN data, transaction-control statements, psql meta commands, non-ASCII dollar tags, concurrent migration coordination, and checksum tracking remain outside scope.
Independent tests were not inspected or executed by the implementer.
